highlights.reason_zh: 可下载权重与 API 同时开放，给开源 coding 和多模态 agent 增加了一个超大稀疏模型选项。
highlights.reason_en: Downloadable weights and an API add a very large sparse option for open-weight coding and multimodal agents.

highlights.reason_zh: 4B 模型把 GUI 与终端路由学进单一策略，并公开代码和训练配方，便于低成本复现。
highlights.reason_en: A 4B model learns GUI/terminal routing in one policy and exposes code and training recipe for lower-cost reproduction.

highlights.reason_zh: 公开 benchmark 直接测量长期 agent 是否能替换过期状态，而不只是检索旧对话。
highlights.reason_en: A public benchmark directly tests whether long-running agents replace stale state rather than merely retrieve old conversation.

highlights.reason_zh: 集中修复续接、压缩和共享环境问题，直接影响长时 coding agent 的可靠性。
highlights.reason_en: Concentrated resume, compaction and shared-environment fixes directly affect long-running coding-agent reliability.

highlights.reason_zh: 凭据、MCP 会话、流式护栏和预算同时变化，既提高边界安全也带来升级风险。
highlights.reason_en: Credentials, MCP sessions, streaming guardrails and budgets change together, improving boundaries while raising upgrade risk.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功读取，并主动补充模型、研究、开源、开发工具、基础设施、政策、小团队与中文一手材料。CWE-bench v2 只有日期精度；论文性能仍待独立验证。 召回自检补录 Kimi K3.1 Pro 与 Mage-VL-Cowork。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were read, with additional discovery across models, research, open source, developer tools, infrastructure, policy, small teams and Chinese-language primary sources. CWE-bench v2 has date-only timing; paper results still need independent validation. Recall audit recovered Kimi K3.1 Pro and Mage-VL-Cowork.
